visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with shoulder-length wavy hair, wearing a green and white striped shirt, stands in a kitchen holding a small glass bowl of green grapes. He points at the bowl while an inset image above him shows a large stainless steel pot containing simmering chicken, ginger slices, and green grapes. (2) Close-up shots of the cooking process: raw chicken chunks are dropped into boiling water, followed by slices of ginger, a pour of rice wine, and a handful of green grapes being tossed into the bubbling pot. (3) A white transition screen appears with the yellow text '20分鐘過後'. Subsequently, a silver ladle scoops up a clear yellow broth containing cooked chicken and softened, pale green grapes. (4) The man is shown holding a blue and white patterned bowl, bringing a spoon to his mouth to taste the soup. As he reacts with a wide smile and bright eyes, animated pink hearts float around him. (5) Detailed shots of the soup bowl show the chicken oil glistening on the surface. The man continues to talk while holding the bowl, gesturing with his hands to describe the texture of the grapes. (6) A new sequence shows the pot now filled with bright orange mandarin segments and chicken. The man demonstrates the mandarin chicken soup, scooping the fruit with a ladle to show the contrast in color. (7) The man stands in the kitchen using chopsticks to lift a soft mandarin segment from a bowl, examining it closely before eating. He makes a 'V' sign with his fingers during his explanation. (8) A woman with dark hair and a white knit top appears at the end of the video, holding a bowl and spoon, looking upwards with a surprised and happy expression while tasting the dish.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: THREADS. [Subtitle]: 爆紅葡萄雞湯. (2) [Subtitle]: 水滾放入川燙雞肉. [Subtitle]: 屈原投薑. [Subtitle]: 米酒. [Subtitle]: 加入葡萄. [Subtitle]: 葡萄又有新生命嗎. [Subtitle]: 中火燉20分鐘. (3) [Variety]: 20分鐘過後. [Subtitle]: 有葡萄的香味. [Subtitle]: 好香哦. [Subtitle]: 起鍋有撒一點鹽巴啦. (4) [Subtitle]: 先喝看看. [Variety]: 很好喝欸. (5) [Subtitle]: 越喝越開胃. [Subtitle]: 雞油飄在葡萄園上的那種優雅. [Subtitle]: 加上濃郁雞香味. [Subtitle]: 其實如果你沒有說它是葡萄做的. [Subtitle]: 有點像是清爽味的瓜仔雞. (6) [Subtitle]: 葡萄雞湯問世之後就有人回饋. [Subtitle]: 用柑橘煮雞湯更好喝. [Subtitle]: 喝起來偏酸一點. [Subtitle]: 但是解膩程度跟葡萄是一樣的. [Subtitle]: 只是看你想要哪一種果汁的口感. (7) [Subtitle]: 唯一可惜的是橘子口感沒有葡萄好. [Subtitle]: 葡萄吃起來有點像大黃瓜. [Subtitle]: 橘子很像一個軟爛的水果在裡面. (8) [Variety]: 哈哈. [Subtitle]: 好好喝欸. [Subtitle]: 不講葡萄不知道.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a male voice speaking at a fast pace with high enthusiasm, introducing a chicken soup recipe. A medium-tempo, upbeat electronic pop track plays consistently in the background. (2) Sounds of water bubbling and splashing occur as chicken is added. The speaker's tone remains bright. A subtle percussive thud is heard as ginger hits the pot, followed by the metallic click of a ladle. (3) A distinct 'ding' sound effect marks a transition. The speaker makes a slurping sound followed by an aspirated 'Ah!' expressing culinary satisfaction. (4) A whimsical sparkle sound effect plays as the speaker laughs, coinciding with visual hearts. The music maintains its steady, positive beat. (5) The narration continues with highly dynamic pitch modulation, describing the soup's flavor. The sound of ceramic bowl clinking against a spoon is clearly audible. (6) The voice shifts slightly to a comparative tone when introducing the mandarin orange variation, maintaining clarity and high arousal. (7) A percussive 'pop' sound effect accompanies the mention of texture. The speaker's delivery becomes more rhythmic. (8) A female voice enters with a sharp, high-pitched exclamation of 'Wow!', sounding genuinely surprised and happy. The BGM swells slightly for the finale.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Recipe Demonstration -> Tasting Review -> Variant Comparison -> Guest Verification
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to test and review a trending internet recipe for 'Green Grape Chicken Soup.' It demonstrates the cooking steps, provides a sensory review of the flavor and texture, and then compares it with a citrus-based variant (Mandarin Orange Chicken Soup) to offer viewers a comprehensive culinary opinion on unconventional fruit-meat combinations.
